column1: Juan López-Belmonte Encina, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of ROVI, said: “We are delighted to be able to
support in the manufacture of medicine that is able to prolong the life of millions of people. Our proven experience in the
manufacture of high-valued-added injectables and the expansion of our production capacities have positioned us to help
meet the rapidly growing demand, which requires a high degree of technological capability.”
